reported.title: Settle filter rejects a valid 13 ms press at the acceptance boundary
reported.description: The debounce in scanTrigger() only accepts a level once it has been stable for SETTLE_MS (12 ms), measured from rawChangedAt, which is stamped when the change is first observed in loop() (lines 41-46). Because loop() polls asynchronously, a press lasting just over 12 ms can be sampled late and the stability window expires only after the button has already been released, so no burst is started; the measured evidence shows "D8 missed 1 of 3 trigger(s): D8 did not start within 100 ms of the trigger at 1.00 s" for the 13 ms glitch case. The filter therefore has no margin over the 8 ms bounce spec and drops legitimate presses near the boundary. D8 missed 1 of 3 trigger(s): D8 did not start within 100 ms of the trigger at 1.00 s.

truth.description: The close time is stored as an absolute millis() value, so a burst that starts within 400 ms of the 32-bit rollover closes at once

judge_input.spec:
- Spray valve relay on D8; trigger button on D2 with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- A settled press on D2 opens the valve (D8 HIGH) for 400 ms, starting within 100 ms of the press.
- Contact bounce up to 8 ms on press and release must not start a second burst.
- Presses while the valve is open are ignored and do not extend it.
- The valve stays closed (D8 LOW) whenever no press has been accepted.
- Print `spray n=<count> open=<0|1>` every 1000 ms.
